nodes.label: Artwork Page Template
nodes.rationale: One artwork per page: a single large photograph (the artwork hanging in situ, not the bare scan) fills the frame, with the collection title as the only running header. Left metadata column holds Title (italic, as the heading), Artist Name, Serie, Media; the right column holds Dimensions, Editions, Date of Creation, Place of Origin. The split separates 'what it is' from 'its physical facts'.

nodes.label: Two-Column Metadata Layout
nodes.rationale: Identity fields sit in the left column and physical/provenance fields in the right, so the eye finds the artist first and the edition provenance second; the same left/right split is reused in the grid layout for consistency.
